description: agent-action checked live after a revocation took effect, carrying a signed_at earlier than the revocation — a live verifier MUST reject with E_REVOKED per SPEC §8.1 step 7

expected.rejection_reason: Verified at 2026-04-24T12:00:00Z. The principal's revocation of v01, signed 2026-04-24T11:59:30Z, is in effect at that time, so a live verifier refuses every action under v01. The action's signed_at (11:59:00Z) is earlier than the revocation, but it is not anchored: it is the agent's claim, and it cannot place the action before a revocation already in effect. Within the 120-second freshness bound, so step 11a passes.
